newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Trade in Von Moos suspended - Swiss bourse.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Von Moos suspended - Swiss bourse.

text.p: Trade in shares of Swiss steel concern Von Moos were suspended in trade on Wednesday morning, the Swiss Stock Exchange said.
Von Moos has set a press conference for Wednesday at 1515 GMT to discuss "structural and personal decisions" with respect to measures pertaining to the company's future strategy.
The Swiss biweekly business journal "Finanz und Wirtschaft" said in an article published on Wednesday that the company is considering changes in its top management.
The paper said that chairman Klaus Hug would be replaced with Robert Jeker. Von Moos declined to comment on the report.
